title: 仲量联行CEO：AI是效率引擎，但人员调整或冲击办公需求
speaker: Christian Ulbrich

segments.en: I mean, I have been literally paranoid about that topic.
segments.zh: 说实话，我对这个话题一直非常警惕。

segments.en: Many, many years and you have to because if it is a threat to your organization then you have to be on top of it very early on.
segments.zh: 多年来一直如此，因为如果它对你的组织构成威胁，你必须尽早掌控它。

segments.en: For now, it is clearly a tailwind for us because we are very people intensive organization and it drives efficiency into our platform.
segments.zh: 目前，它显然对我们有利，因为我们是一家人力密集型组织，AI提升了我们的运营效率。

segments.en: That means we can grow revenues very significantly without adding a lot of new headcount.
segments.zh: 这意味着我们可以在不大幅增加人手的情况下显著提升营收。

segments.en: Now, we're also watching could that be something which is a risk to us? And the risk could be on two sides.
segments.zh: 同时，我们也在关注它是否可能带来风险，风险可能来自两个方面。

segments.en: It could be that overall jobs are being lost and therefore there's less space for us to take care of going forward because our clients need have less space needs.
segments.zh: 一方面，整体就业岗位可能减少，客户对办公空间的需求也会下降，我们管理的空间就会减少。

segments.en: So that is for us the bigger topic. Every job cut is a desk you don't need anymore. Potentially, yes.
segments.zh: 所以这对我们来说是个更大的课题。每一次裁员，就意味着少一张办公桌。

segments.en: And then it could also be is there anything coming which would potentially disintermediate us in some of our services?
segments.zh: 另一方面，是否会出现某种力量，可能在某些服务环节绕过我们？

segments.en: For now, we see nothing on either of those two so I have to say for now it's clearly a tailwind but we're obviously very much on the front foot to see whether that may change and at some point there also a couple of headwinds coming to us.
segments.zh: 目前，这两方面我们都没看到明显迹象，所以现在它显然是顺风。但我们保持警觉，关注变化，未来也可能出现逆风。

segments.en: but we're obviously very much on the front foot to see whether that may change and at some point there also a couple of headwinds coming to us.
segments.zh: 我们正积极观察，看情况是否变化，未来也可能出现一些逆风。
